dct_title_s: Important farmlands, Jackson County, West Virginia
dct_alternative_sm: Jackson County, West Virginia, important farmlands
dct_description_sm: Shows "Prime farmland" and "Additional farmland of statewide and local importance."; "Interpretations derived from soil map constructed in 1961 by Cartographic Division, Soil Conservation Service, USDA, of Jackson County, West Virginia."; "Base source: USGS 1:100,000 county base dated 1978."; "Projection and 10,000-metre grid ticks, zone 17: Universal Transverse Mercator. 25,000-foot grid ticks based on West Virginia coordinate system south zone."; Includes location map and inset of southern portion.
